title: C18 Test 1 Section 1: Transport Survey - Commuter Feedback
instructions: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

sentences.textEn: Cambridge IELTS 18, Listening Test 1. Section 1. You will hear a transport survey being conducted at a railway station. First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 4.
sentences.textZh: 剑桥雅思 18 听力测试 1，第一部分。你将听到在火车站进行的一项交通调查。首先，你有时间查看第 1 至 4 题。

sentences.textEn: Good morning. Could you spare a few minutes to complete a transport survey?
sentences.textZh: 早上好。请问您能抽几分钟完成一份交通出行问卷调查吗？

sentences.textEn: Sure, I have about ten minutes before my next train arrives.
sentences.textZh: 当然可以，距离我的下一趟火车进站还有大约十分钟。

sentences.textEn: Great, thank you! First, can I take your full name and occupation for our records?
sentences.textZh: 太好了，谢谢您！首先，我能记录一下您的全名和职业吗？

sentences.textEn: Yes, it's Luisa Gould, and I work as an environmental consultant in the city center.
sentences.textZh: 可以，我是路易莎·古尔德（Luisa Gould），我在市中心担任环境顾问（consultant）。

sentences.textEn: And what is the main purpose of your journey today? Is it for commuting or leisure?
sentences.textZh: 请问您今天出行的主要目的是什么？是日常通勤还是休闲娱乐？

sentences.textEn: I use the train primarily for commuting to work, typically 5 days a week.
sentences.textZh: 我坐火车主要是为了通勤（commuting）上班，通常一周 5 天。

sentences.textEn: Thank you. Now, before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 5 to 10.
sentences.textZh: 谢谢。在听对话余下部分前，你有时间查看第 5 至 10 题。

sentences.textEn: Now listen and answer questions 5 to 10.
sentences.textZh: 现在请听录音并回答第 5 至 10 题。

sentences.textEn: How would you rate the peak hour service? Are you satisfied with the punctuality of the trains?
sentences.textZh: 您如何评价高峰时段的班次？您对火车的准点率（punctuality）满意吗？

sentences.textEn: Punctuality is generally fine, but the railway carriages are often severely overcrowded in the mornings.
sentences.textZh: 准点率总体还可以，但早上的车厢经常极其拥挤（overcrowded）。

sentences.textEn: Is there a particular time when overcrowding is at its worst?
sentences.textZh: 车厢拥挤是在哪个具体时间段最严重呢？

sentences.textEn: It is definitely at its peak between 8 and 9 AM when everyone is trying to reach their offices.
sentences.textZh: 绝对是在上午 8 点到 9 点（9 AM）之间，这时所有人都在赶着去公司。

sentences.textEn: What type of rail ticket do you normally buy for your daily travel?
sentences.textZh: 您平时日常出行通常购买哪种类型的火车票？

sentences.textEn: I purchase a monthly season ticket, but train fares have risen significantly over the past year.
sentences.textZh: 我买的是包月的季票/定期票（season ticket），但过去一年里火车票价上涨得非常显著（significantly）。

sentences.textEn: The recent price increase has been particularly hard on university students and low-income interns.
sentences.textZh: 最近的票价上涨对大学生（students）和低收入实习生来说尤其困难。

sentences.textEn: I appreciate your detailed feedback. We will submit these insights to the regional rail transport authority.
sentences.textZh: 非常感谢您的详尽反馈。我们将把这些意见提交给区域铁路运输管理局。

sentences.textEn: That is the end of Section 1. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
sentences.textZh: 第一部分到此结束。你现在有半分钟时间检查你的答案。
